# Review Skill

Use this skill to review the implementation before approval.

Procedure:
1. Read the approved SDLC artifacts and the implementation under review.
2. Check correctness, security, dependency safety, error handling, test coverage, clarity, and maintainability.
3. Record issues and recommendations without applying fixes automatically.
4. Require human approval before any fix is applied.
5. Report findings clearly and concisely.

Do not silently fix issues during review.
